{{Top|leg}}
'''Battle spread''' was the name of a formation used by a pair of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] flying in hostile territory. The two fighters flew side-by-side at a range of between two hundred and three hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] apart.
